name: Adjuster note with uncued, lowercase names (NER)
description: Run with nerDetector over a stub recognizer that knows `nerNames` (case-insensitive). Regex alone misses the uncued 'jordan ellery' and its capitalised repeat; with NER both are masked, the cued claimant is still found by regex, her first name propagates, and the policy number stays.
text:
ADJUSTER NOTE — Claim # CLM-77120. Policy No. 512-555-0147.
spoke with jordan ellery at the body shop; the estimate is approved. Claimant: Priya Natarajan, phone (512) 555-0143.
Left a voicemail for Jordan Ellery about the rental. Priya will send photos to priya.n@example.com.
